document.title: The Law Of Manu Tamil And Hindi
document.author: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar

content.full_text: The Law of Manu. It belongs to Brahmin caste. They wrote it to make the Indian people as slaves.  The present Indian constitution was written by Dr.B.R.Ambedkar. Before Ambedkar wrote there was another Indian constitution which is called Manusmirti
